verdict.rationale: Honeybadger lets users define event-driven rules. Insights Alarms pair a BadgerQL query with a threshold and fire alerts when it is crossed. Integrations let you choose which error events create a notification or ticket. Webhooks (now with bearer-token auth) can kick off external automations such as Cursor Automations, and deploys can auto-resolve open errors. Missing for 10: actions are limited to alerts, tickets and webhooks with no general rule/action workflow engine; rule conditions and options are thinly documented; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
